environment.plugin_package: dsh-plugin-claude-code 0.2.1 source tree at commit 22db620, linked into the profile
environment.dsh_home: isolated DSH_HOME; profile from the shipped headless template
environment.profile_patch: agent-default-model claude-code-session/haiku; tool-subagent with modelSelection true and modelDiscovery true
environment.route: claude-code-session; parent model haiku; requested child model sonnet

cause.rule: A session with no recorded subagent/model-selection-policy event permits an explicit child route only when it is equal to the parent route. list_subagent_models then shows the parent model only.
cause.setting: Host service @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings (entry id subagent-model-selection-settings), fields enabled and allowedModels. The web and desktop profiles show it on Plugins, Subagent, Model selection.
cause.sampling: dsh records the route list in each new top-level session when the agent is created. A child session inherits it. A later settings change applies to new sessions only.
cause.plugin_catalog: The plugin lists each model from supportedModels(). The enabled run shows that dsh reads this list.

method: One task text for both runs: call list_subagent_models with no arguments, with the provider, and with the provider and model sonnet; then start a subagent with provider claude-code-session and model sonnet and the prompt "Reply with the single word PONG."
Control run: dsh --profile <profile> --json with the profile patch only.
Policy run: the same command plus --patch with an overlay that inserts the settings service with enabled true and allowedModels claude-code-session/haiku and claude-code-session/sonnet.
Read the dsh session logs of the parent session and the child session after each run.

checks.item: Without a recorded policy, a child route on another model is refused
observed: list_subagent_models({}) returned: claude-code-session — Claude Code session
list_subagent_models({provider}) returned one model: claude-code-session/haiku — Haiku 5.5
list_subagent_models({provider, model: sonnet}) failed: child LLM route "claude-code-session/sonnet" is not allowed for this Session

subagent({provider, model: sonnet}) failed: child LLM route "claude-code-session/sonnet" is not allowed for this Session; without a recorded model-selection policy, explicit selection (including reasoning_effort) is limited to the parent route
The parent session log has no subagent/model-selection-policy event.

checks.item: With the dsh setting enabled, a session on one Claude model starts a subagent on another allowed Claude model
observed: The parent session log has a subagent/model-selection-policy event with the two routes. The child session log has the same event.
list_subagent_models({provider}) returned claude-code-session/sonnet — Sonnet 5.5 and claude-code-session/haiku — Haiku 5.5, with the catalog descriptions.
list_subagent_models({provider, model: sonnet}) returned the efforts low, medium, high, xhigh, max.
subagent({provider, model: sonnet}) returned: started subagent <id>. The parent reported the child answer PONG.
The parent session log records the served model claude-haiku-5-5. The child session log records the requested model sonnet and the served model claude-sonnet-5-5.

rules_check.route: The child uses the same claude-code-session route, the same official executable, and the same first-party subscription check. The plugin changed no header and read no credential.
rules_check.signed_thinking: The child has its own dsh session and its own native Claude session. No signed thinking block moves between the parent session and the child session.

model_requests: The two runs sent a small number of haiku requests and one sonnet child turn through the subscription route.
raw_outputs: .local/evidence/subagent-model-selection-2026-11-11/ (control-out.jsonl, policy-out.jsonl, the task text, and the two patch files)
not_proven: The settings page of the web or desktop app was not operated. The measurement set the same Host service fields through a profile patch overlay.
A child on claude-fable-5-2 or opus was not run. The policy is an exact route list, and the catalog lists these ids.
An explicit child route on the subagent_fork tool. The shipped presets do not expose route fields on that tool.
Retention of signed thinking in the child session.
